mechanic.summary: Kezkitt channels into each Lightblossom, increasing its eventual group damage unless the beam is intercepted.
mechanic.response: Stand on the blossom inside the beam—not in front of the blossom—to prevent Light-Gorged stacks.

provenance.description: Compact tactical classification from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Blinding Vale guide and linked spell record.
